changelog:
live-neon-persona 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Manage persistent, evolving AI agent identities on the Live Neon platform.
- Fetch structured identities, sync content, run principle-based discovery, and build runtime prompts.
- Review and approve beliefs & responsibilities with full provenance and approval workflows.
- Integrates with diverse content sources (GitHub, web, RSS, social) to continuously update agent identity.
- Command-line invocable; see SKILL.md for quick start and comprehensive API usage.
summary: Manage AI agent identities on the Live Neon platform — fetch identity, sync content, run discovery, review beliefs, build prompts
